x1.description: scalar or array. Specifies one of the legs of right angle triangle. ``complex`` dtype are not supported.
constraints: x1 must be one of complex
x1 and x2 must either have same shape or be broadcast compatible

x2.description: scalar or array. Specifies the other leg of right angle triangle. ``complex`` dtype are not supported. ``x1`` and ``x2`` must either have same shape or be broadcast compatible.
constraints: x2 must be one of complex
x1 and x2 must either have same shape or be broadcast compatible

output.description: An array containing the hypotenuse for the given given legs ``x1`` and ``x2`` of a right angle triangle, promoting to inexact dtype.

constraints: x1 and x2 must either have same shape or be broadcast compatible
